name: Muramite Citadel: Barracks
summary: The primary housing and training grounds for Muramite soldiers.
description: The Barracks form the backbone of Muramite troop strength. Rows of Discord‑reinforced dormitories, training pits, supply racks, and muster yards fill the area. Legionnaires drill relentlessly, ascenders train for vertical assaults, and beast handlers maintain war beasts in reinforced pens. Dragorn infiltrators rarely survive entry, as the Barracks are always active, loud, and heavily patrolled.
